{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Dahara City |image=Dahara City.png |imagesize=300px |characters=デセルシティ |japanese=Désert City |region=Kalos |colorscheme=ORAS |epicode=Hoopa — The Mischief Pokémon }} '''Dahara City''' (Japanese: '''デセルシティ''' ''Désert City'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]] and one of the settings of ''[[M18|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]''. Sitting by an inlet in the desert, Dahara City is a sprawling metropolis with towering skyscrapers surrounded by stone houses. One of its landmarks is the [[Dahara Tower]]. [[File:Dahara City past.png|thumb|left|220px|Dahara City 100 years ago]] One hundred years ago, Dahara City was just a small village. One day, {{an|Hoopa}} [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Hoopa|Unbound]] emerged from a ring. It started to steal food, which made the villagers angry. To repay them, Hoopa showered them with gold. As a result, the town grew and prospered. In return for more food, Hoopa granted the villagers wishes. The villagers wanted to see Hoopa in battle, so they had it fight strong Pokémon. Hoopa eventually got carried away by fighting, and started to summon [[Legendary Pokémon]] like {{p|Regigigas}}, {{p|Reshiram}} and {{p|Zekrom}} to test its strength. When the cataclysmic battle between these immensely powerful Pokémon nearly destroyed Dahara City, a lone man from [[Arche Valley]] called [[Ghris]] stepped forward and sealed Hoopa in the [[Prison Bottle]], saving the village. Due to the wealth Hoopa had brought the village earlier, it would eventually grow into a sprawling city. It debuted in ''[[Hoopa — The Mischief Pokémon]]''. As [[Baraz]], [[Meray]] and Hoopa had split ways in their search for the Prison Bottle, Meray and Hoopa eventually saw the skyline of Dahara City in the distance. In ''[[M18|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]'', {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} decided to pay it a visit, and met Baraz, Meray and Hoopa along the way. When the Prison Bottle broke during a confrontation with {{TRT}}, Hoopa's evil power manifested itself into a separate Hoopa Unbound and started to wreak havoc on Dahara City again. Hoopa Unbound summoned many Legendary Pokémon once more and had them fight against other Legendary Pokémon summoned by Hoopa Confined and commanded by Ash. Parts of Dahara City were destroyed in the battle, but Baraz and Meray managed to create another Prison Bottle and sealed away Hoopa's evil power. Although Dahara City seemed safe now, time and space started to warp around Dahara Tower due to too many Legendary Pokémon having been summoned to one place. Ash transformed Hoopa into Hoopa Unbound using the new Prison Bottle, now not turning it evil because the evil power had disappeared. Hoopa Unbound managed to transport the people around the tower to a safe location with its rings. The distortion ultimately completely consumed Dahara Tower, but not before {{p|Arceus}} appeared over Dahara City to save Baraz who had been trapped in the middle of the distortion. ==In the manga== [[File:Dahara City M18 manga.png|thumb|200px|Dahara City in ''{{ma|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages}}'']] [[File:Dahara City past M18 manga.png|thumb|left|200px|Dahara City in ''Hoopa and the Clash of Ages'']] ===Movie adaptations=== Dahara City appeared in ''{{ma|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages}}''. {{sectionstub}} {{-}} ==Trivia== * The Japanese name of Dahara City, Désert City, was used as the [[Original Trainer|OT]] of {{p|Kyogre}}, {{p|Groudon}}, {{p|Dialga}}, {{p|Palkia}}, {{p|Kyurem}}, {{p|Giratina}}, and {{p|Arceus}} event distributions for Japan and South Korea in 2015 to 2016. With the exception of [[Dahara City Arceus|Arceus]], these Pokémon were summoned by {{an|Hoopa}} Unbound in the eighteenth movie. ===Origin=== {{main|Pokémon world in relation to the real world#In the movies|Pokémon world in relation to the real world → In the movies}} Dahara City is based on {{wp|Dubai}}Location Scouting Report (Chapter 1: To the City in the Desert!) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20180817112615/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/pokemovie_ch/?p=132 archived]) (Japanese) ([https://dogasu.bulbagarden.net/movies/2015_xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa/xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa_location_scouting.html English translation by Dogasu]), the most populous city of the {{wp|United Arab Emirates}}. Dubai is located in the {{wp|Arabian Desert}}, where it sits by the coast of the {{wp|Persian Gulf}}. It is also the {{wp|List of tallest buildings in Dubai|site}} of some of the world's tallest skyscrapers with the {{wp|Burj Khalifa}} currently being the world's tallest structure. Dahara City parallels the collection of architectural styles in Dubai that ranges from traditional to modern interpretation of {{wp|Islamic architecture}}. Director [[Kunihiko Yuyama]] and his team {{wp|Location scouting|scouted}} the historic district of {{wp|Al Bastakiya}} with the nearby {{wp|Dubai Museum}}Location Scouting Report (Chapter 5: To Old Dubai!) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20180817111342/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/pokemovie_ch/?p=414 archived]) (Japanese) ([https://dogasu.bulbagarden.net/movies/2015_xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa/xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa_location_scouting.html English translation by Dogasu]) and the areas around the {{wp|Dubai Creek}} with the waterfront promenade of {{wp|Deira Corniche}} and traditional souks such as {{wp|Dubai Textile Souk}}, {{wp|Dubai Spice Souk}}, and {{wp|Dubai Gold Souk}}Location Scouting Report (Chapter 7: Souk! Souk! Souk!) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20171024143619/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/pokemovie_ch/?p=606 archived]) (Japanese) ([https://dogasu.bulbagarden.net/movies/2015_xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa/xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa_location_scouting.html English translation by Dogasu]), along with the modern infrastructuresLocation Scouting Report (Chapter 11: Burj Khalifa and the World's Greatest) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20180817104736/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/pokemovie_ch/?p=957 archived]) (Japanese) ([https://dogasu.bulbagarden.net/movies/2015_xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa/xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa_location_scouting.html English translation by Dogasu])Location Scouting Report (Chapter 13: Palm Jumeirah and the Valley of Buildings) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20180817101647/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/pokemovie_ch/?p=1236 archived]) (Japanese) ([https://dogasu.bulbagarden.net/movies/2015_xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa/xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa_location_scouting.html English translation by Dogasu]) in the city such as the {{wp|Dubai Mall}}, the Burj Khalifa, the {{wp|Dubai Marina}}, and the {{wp|Palm Jumeirah}}.
